cc_d11.name: Superdense Color Code d=11, r=11, p=0.001

A_bp_computational.description: Scalar single-shot BP on monolithic graph (no SIMD batching, no compaction, no multipass)

B_bp_algorithmic.description: Parallel flooding schedule + fixed check order + no cross-pass reweighting
+ Layered serial check schedule (in-place message updates)
+ Soft cross-pass LLR reweighting (75% conditional / 25% channel prior)

C_osd_computational.description: Full rank(H) RREF + all N columns + full O(N log N) std::sort
+ Residual-syndrome early exit during Gauss-Jordan RREF
+ K = 1.2*M active column truncation prior to matrix build/RREF
+ O(N + K log K) std::nth_element partial sort

D_osd_algorithmic.description: Pure BP baseline (no OSD post-processing, --osd-order -1)
OSD-0 seeded from final BP iteration L^(T) only
+ Minimum-syndrome BP snapshot L^(t*) seeding
+ 2 Damped BP Relay Legs (R1: gamma=0.875/d=1/8, R2: gamma=0.625/d=2/8)
+ Prior-blended alpha-ISD seeds (alpha in {0.35, 0.65}) + OSD-10 search
